name: Merrytime Mexican Riviera Roasted Pollo Asado & Baja Mojo Pork Loin
brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder & Magic · Merrytime Mexican Riviera Cruise Specials
whyItWorks: Lean roasted chicken breast and pork tenderloin carved on Mexican Riviera sailings; very safe when ordered plain without citrus-chile marinade.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Ask the galley or carving station for plain herb-roasted chicken or pork tenderloin with steamed white rice—strictly without sour orange/lime mojo or chipotle glaze.
watchOuts: CITRUS & SPICE WARNING: Traditional Baja mojo uses sour orange/lime juice and chipotle uses smoked jalapeño
